verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects has its own no-code built-in workflows that automatically set fields when items are added or changed, and project templates can carry these configured workflows. Nothing shows these can be chained into multi-step automations. The GraphQL API and GitHub Actions require writing code, so they are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-step or chained no-code automation, conditional logic, a visual builder, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Built-in workflows allow you to automatically set fields when items are added or changed
Project templates include the views, custom fields, draft issues and associated fields, configured workflows (except any auto-add workflows), and insights.
